reviews.text: Daycare where puppies learn and have fun.
Max is the happiest and most spoiled when he goes; we are very satisfied with the accommodations and the parties.
My Berny loves going to play, they treat the dogs so well! Highly recommended, Dr. Monse is the best! Thank you for the support with Berny to the whole Canem & Feles team

It's not a veterinary clinic at all!! Don't advertise what you're not!! I went to inquire about boarding my dog, and the place was tiny and smelled bad… always be clear about your prices. Luckily, I didn't leave my dog ​​there.

My kids absolutely love it. Ever since Canem opened, they've been going there and they've been obsessed. They have specialized staff because Pia is deaf and they give her the appropriate care, and Don Pepe is a grumpy old man and they take great care of him. I recommend it 10000000%!

What a lovely place to leave my dog! They treat them with so much love and patience, and they make sure there are no problems among them, that they're with the dogs they get along with best. They also throw them really nice parties; Totto never misses one <3
Excellent veterinary clinic and daycare, I highly recommend it.
I love them! They always pamper and take great care of Capo when he stays with them at daycare. They also always give him a nice bath 🐶🧽 …

Canem is the best pet daycare. My dog ​​has been a regular customer for two years and loves going so much that he gets excited whenever we drive by and wants to stay even if it's not the right place. They've also celebrated two of his birthdays there with his furry friends.
